# Copilot instructions

This repository contains the Cold Read skill. When asked to research or assess a company, a deal, an engineering stack, job ads, a named competitor, a prospective partner or named people at a company, follow `skills/cold-read/SKILL.md` and its `references/` files. Use the public record only, mark every claim as cited, inferred or unknown, never open LinkedIn profiles, never sign up for a trial or use a pretext to read a competitor, and confirm infrastructure findings in words before quoting them to the company.
